events.summary: Ran the eight record checks; P1, P2, P6, P8 did not pass.

The checks show significant issues:
- P1: Station coverage is only 32.3% (10 of 31 days), well below the 80% minimum

The gauge record is clearly unfit. Let me investigate the actual data from both sources to understand the situation better.

input.body:
Dear Farmer Group,

Your claim CLM-LAG-2025-003 (policy POL-LAG-2025-016) has been settled.

**Outcome: PAY — NGN 184,000**

**Why:** The reference gauge (NIM00065201) provided data for only 10 of 31 days in July 2025 (32% coverage). On several days it reported 0 mm while the satellite recorded rain (e.g., 14.3 mm on 8 July), and it reported 6.1 mm on 23 July when the satellite saw 0 mm. The gauge record is therefore unfit as the sole index.

The satellite series (POWER) is complete for all 31 days and shows 131.65 mm for July 2025. This is below the policy trigger of 144.3 mm but above the exit of 61.8 mm, so a payout is due. Historical Julys at your location (2001–2024) range from 117 mm to 416 mm; 2025 is among the driest on record, consistent with your report that July rains failed.

The payout of NGN 184,000 has been approved and will be disbursed.

Yours sincerely,
Pluvia Claims
